subject: list.files() for local paths but a web hosted app

messages.author: f1b145af323f7b0b
messages.subject: list.files() for local paths but a web hosted app
parts:
Has anyone used the list.files function in a shiny app that is hosted on the web?  My application reads all of the .xls files in a local directory, stacks them, and then does a round of checks.  Rather than install perl on everybody's machine I would like to host the app on the web but the users will need to be able to stack the .xls files that are located locally on their machine.

Any ideas?
Tyler
